name: devkit
description: Developer productivity CLI with nightly automated commits

scripts.build: pnpm --filter devkit-core build && pnpm --filter devkit-cli build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter devkit-core lint && pnpm --filter devkit-cli lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter devkit-core test && pnpm --filter devkit-cli test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter devkit-core typecheck && pnpm --filter devkit-cli typecheck
